fullPassage: In order to prevent plants from dying, good ventilation is necessary. For transpiration, one of the plant’s processes, to occur, air circulation is invaluable. Inadequate ventilation may cause pest infestations to occur and (cause) mold to grow on the soil. Ideally, place plants somewhere well ventilated where they can receive a natural breeze. If they are shut indoors while you are out create air flow with an air circulator or fan. If your living environment permits it, installing a ceiling fan is also a good idea. However don’t allow plants to come in direct contact with strong winds from air conditioning or fans. The leaves and stems will get extremely dry, which is hard on plants. Instead make sure (that) plants are getting gentle breezes from various directions. [transpiration in order to V so as to V for to S V However, Instead, EBS Light
